Commentary.Commentary: That is all from this game. The result panned out to be how everyone expected it to with India coming out on top quite easily. Bangladesh on the other hand, are struggling to find a win. They have a lot of things to sought out before their next game against the Lankans. It is also the next game of the tri series which will be played on the 10th of March in Colombo at 1900 local (1330 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

Rohit Sharma says this good performance was expected from his team, from the first ball to the last and it was a complete team effort. Mentions they looked at what went wrong in the last game and worked on it, in particular what lengths they hit while bowling. Praises his bowlers for executing their plans and is happy with how they did. Realizes that their catching has been poor and goes on to say there's always room for improvement. Reckons his side is much better than that and hopefully they'll improve rather soon.

Mahmudullah says it's obvious they didn't bat well. Adds they fell short by about 15-20 runs and didn't adapt to the wicket as well. Further adds they needed to rotate the strike more and do better especially in the middle overs. States that they are just one win away from becoming really good again and that probably isn't far away.

Man of the Match, Vijay Shankar says he's been working really hard and is happy to have got this award. Adds that the last few years he's put in a lot of effort to develop his bowling and add some variety, which has helped him a lot. Wants to thank his parents for helping him get to this point, along with the people in the dressing room.

India back on track after a mini setback in the tournament opener and with that, they continue to dominate Bangladesh as they make it 6-0 in T20Is. Was as comfortable a game as they could have hoped for. First did the job with the ball by restricting Bangladesh to 139, with Jaydev Unadkat leading the charge with a 3 fer, and now, have cruised through the chase courtesy a superb Shikhar Dhawan fifty. His and Suresh Raina's stand of 68 runs more or less sealed the deal, with Manish Pandey then adding the finishing touches like he usually does. Plenty to ponder for the Tigers, time to rejoice for the Indians.

And there's the game! INDIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS! Comfortable victory for the Men in Blue. Manish Pandey hits this towards the man at cover and calls his partner through to complete a well-deserved victory.
On a good length and around off, a mistimed drive towards the covers.
Length ball outside the line of off stump, cut away towards the covers, where a half-stop from the fielder lets the batsmen take a single.
Just back of a length, slightly cramped for room but it doesn't matter to Pandey who punches it down the ground for a single.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Shouldn't be bowling there to Pandey. He has width, so he uses it well and cuts it fiercely through cover-point for a boundary.
Angling in sharply, Pandey picks it off his pads and works it 'round the corner, but finds the man positioned there.
Bit of width offered outside off, cut down to third man by Dinesh Karthik for a run.
Glided with an open face again, but straight to the third man fielder this time. Single taken.

FOUR! Deft from Manish Pandey. Nicely done. Plays this very late. Waits for the ball to come, opens the face and just guides it past the keeper. Really fine, even the third man fielder can't get to it with a dive. Boundary!
Mustafizur Rahman returns.
Single to end the over. Pandey pushes it through the cover region and will keep strike. 14 to win in 3 overs.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Pandey uppishly plays it through the gap in the covers for an easy two.
Dinesh Karthik to bat next for India.

OUT! Dhawan is on his way, but the wicket's probably come a little too late. Full and angling in from around off from around the wicket, the opener walks a step across and looks to clear mid-wicket. Lot of height, not enough distance and Liton Das gets under this. Judges it well and takes a safe catch.
Back of a length and angling back in, Manish Pandey swats it across, through mid-wicket, and calls his partner through for one.
Touch fuller in length, quite close to the off stick, it's driven down to long off. Another run to the scoreboard.
Waits for the length ball outside off to come to him, and then opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man for a single.
Taskin Ahmed to bowl once more.
Dhawan looks to get some bat on it, does so too but it's the inside edge which falls past the leg stump.
Driven down through mid on for an easy run.
FOUR! A half-tracker, basically a gift for Manish Pandey who puts this away with a lot of joy. Rocks back and pulls it across the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.

Definite noise there, not sure of what though. Rahim went up instantly after collecting the ball. No response from the umpire though. Dropped a little short on off, spins away ever so slightly and goes past the outside edge. Think the sound was of the bat hitting the back pad. Good call from the official.
Over the wicket to Dhawan, it's darted full and on the stumps, driven to long on. One more run taken.
Tossed up on off from around the wicket, comfortably pushed down the ground towards long off. A single is taken.
Short ball rising off the surface, Pandey rises tall and rides the bounce as he punches it through covers for a single. 27 off 30 now to win.
Shortish delivery into the body, a little swivel from Shikhar before he pulls it through backward square leg. One run to the total.
Back of a length delivery going across Dhawan, he cuts it square but straight to the fielder.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Pandey drops it in front of cover and crosses over.
Super way to get off the mark. Short ball and Pandey plays the ramp shot to this. Would have got a boundary too, had Mustafizur not made a good tumbling stop to his left at third man. Two taken.
Manish Pandey walks in next.

OUT! Rubel strikes immediately on his return to the attack. It's the short ball which does Raina in. He awkwardly fends it away on the leg side, scoops it towards Mehidy Hasan at square leg who takes a simple catch. Bangladesh have another wicket, but India are in a really comfortable position. 32 needed off 35.
Rubel Hossain comes back on.
Use of the feet again, played down towards mid on for a quick run.
Walks down the track and dabs it to long on for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.

Skidding off the surface after pitching outside off, Dhawan is beaten past the outside edge as he looks to play and the ball goes off the keeper's pads. A stumping chance missed, as Dhawan dragged his back leg outside the crease.

FOUR! 6th T20I fifty for Shikhar Dhawan! He gets to the milestone with a boundary. Darted down the leg side, Dhawan helps it on its way to the fine leg fence. Another good knock from the southpaw opener, his purple patch continues.
Darted too full on the stumps, flicked in front of square leg for a single.
Nazmul Islam is on to bowl.
Driven towards mid off. No run taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Gets close to the pitch of the ball with the use of his feet and pushes it to long off for one.
SIX! Short, flat and on the stumps, Dhawan quickly picks it up and positions himself for the big hoick. He clears the mid-wicket boundary with ease and gets a biggie to his name.
Knocks this ball down to long on and crosses over.
The 50-run stand is up with this. Raina works the ball square on the leg side with the angle. Picks up two with ease.
Mahmudullah brings himself into the attack.
Attacking the stumps, Suresh Raina makes room and steers it towards point. The fielder there dives and makes a good stop, can't stop the batsmen from completing the run though.
Sharp bumper, going slightly down leg, Raina has nothing to do with it.
Served on a length once more, a fraction straight in line, Dhawan swings hard over square leg. Takes a run as the fielder out in the deep mops it up.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, worked through the square leg area for an easy one.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Raina makes a little room for himself before he eases the punch through to sweeper cover for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call as it is flicking the leg stump. Dhawan comes down the track and he tries to flick the ball. He misses though to get hit on the pads. The bowler and the keeper put in a loud appeal but the umpire once again shakes his head. This time though they go for the review. Replays roll in and the ball shows to be clipping the leg pole. The on-field call stays and Bangladesh don't lose their review.
Review time! Another appeal for an LBW against Dhawan has been turned down. The Bangladeshis this time go for a review. Looks to be going down leg with the angle.
Loopy ball on off, driven to covers.

Another appeal but to no avail! Fires it on off, Dhawan goes down on one knee and tries to sweep. He misses and it hits some part of his body. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Replays later on show it did not hit the pads and it had hit the glove.
Floated up on off, driven through covers for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Works it with the angle through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Trademark Raina! He makes room, gets the ball in his zone, full and wide outside off. Suresh goes inside out over covers for a boundary. 59 needed of 60.
Full and wide outside off, Raina makes room but he goes too far outside leg. He tries to reach the ball but it takes the bottom edge and goes to point.
Fuller on middle, worked across the line and through mid-wicket for a run.
Wide outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
A bumper which bounces way above the batsman's head and the umpire calls it a wide.
The batsman dances down the track. They pick up a single.
Good length on off, kept out.
Soumya Sarkar into the attack now.
That stays low! Quicker on off, skids off the surface and also stays low. Raina does well though to get his bat down in time and keep it out.
Shorter on off, punched to covers for a run.
Delicate glance by the batsman through the fine leg region. One run added to the total.

A huge, huge appeal by the bowler. He bowls the arm ball on middle, coming into the batsman with the angle. Dhawan tries to work it around the corner but misses. The bowler is pleading as he feels he has got his man but the umpire shakes his head. Going down leg. Also the batsmen take a leg bye as the ball rolls towards short third man.
Fires it on the pads, Raina works it around the corner. They run the first one hard, sensing an opportunity for a second but it was not on.
Dances down the track but does not quite get to the pitch of the ball. He still manages to get a run off it as he flicks it through mid-wicket.

13 from the over! Full and outside off, Dhawan tries to drive but the ball takes the inside edge and onto his pads. It rolls towards the off side for a quick run. A good comeback from the bowler after going for 10 in the first 2 balls of the over.
On the pads, worked around the corner for an easy run.
Shortish again, Dhawan is in such good form that he picks the length early and pulls it but this time to the fielder in the deep on the leg side for a run.
Fuller on off, pushed to covers. Better delivery by Taskin but he has to bowl here consistently.

FOUR! Dhawan is in a hurry here! 75 needed now in 76! Short again, Taskin is not learning here. Dhawan though loves it as he camps back and pulls it with authority through backward square leg for another boundary. 10 from the first two balls.

SIX! Welcome back Taskin, says Dhawan! A hit me ball by Ahmed. A bouncer down the leg side, Dhawan just has to get bat on it and he does so expertly. He helps it on its way and the ball goes flying over the fine leg fence.
Taskin Ahmed is back on.
Flighted ball on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Gives it air on off, driven towards cover.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
SIX! 50 up in style! The drop has already cost them 8 runs. Hasan floats it up on middle, Raina goes down on one knee and sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Fires it on off, kept out.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.

PUT DOWN! Bangladesh needed this to stick if they are to win this game. A well worked out plan almost paid off. There was a leg gully in place for Raina and Rubel bowls it full on the pads. Raina flicks it uppishly towards him. Hasan there dives to his left and gets two hands to it but can't hang on. The batsmen take a single in the meantime. How costly will this prove? Raina would surely want to make the Bangladeshis pay.
The batsman plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Short and pulled away! A bumper on middle, Dhawan rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Raina hops and defends it towards covers. He sets off for a run. The fielder there has a shy and Raina dives but the fielder misses.
Suresh Raina walks out to the middle.

OUT! Another chop on and it is not a surprise seeing the nature of the wicket! Pant's promotion up the order has not worked! Once again a change of ends for a bowler does the trick. Rubel bowls it wide outside off, on a fuller length, the sucker ball they call it. Pant throws the kitchen sink at it but away from his body. He gets an inside edge which shatters into the stumps. The Bangladeshis are pumped and they have two in the Powerplay. They are not making it easy for India. 100 more needed.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
Floats it up on off, Pant plays it towards cover to end the over with a run.

Pant comes down the track, seeing that Mehidy drags his length back. Pant tries to keep it out but the ball hits his pads. There is a muted appeal by the Bangladeshi players but the umpire shakes his head.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Nicely swept! Dhawan loves to play this shot against the off spinners. Mehidy tosses it up on middle, Dhawan goes down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Fires it on off, Pant drops it towards cover for a quick run.
Flatter on off, no turn on offer. Pant lunges forward and keeps it out.
Time for some spin! Mehidy Hasan is into the attack.
Another heave but this time he does not connect well. The ball which is full takes the inside edge and goes towards deep square leg for a run. End of a successful over for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller this time by Rahman, Pant flicks him over mid on to get off the mark with a boundary.
A confident shot first up by Pant! Short and on middle, Rishabh takes on the challenge of pulling and does it well but straight to short fine leg.
Rishabh Pant is the next man in. He has been promoted up the order today.

OUT! PLAYED ON! The change of ends for Mustafizur Rahman does the trick. Another failure for Rohit Sharma. Rahman comes running in and lands it on a length around off. Sharma tries to run it down to third man but the ball is too close to him to play that shot. He gets an inside edge which disturbs the furniture behind. A much-needed wicket for Bangladesh as these two were taking the game away from them. They would now look to pull things back a little.
Fullish on off, I think it was the cutter. Sharma times it to covers but for no runs. He is on 17 from 12 balls.
Flicks it with the angle through square leg for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.

Fuller on middle, Dhawan times it towards the bowler who half stops it and deflects it towards mid on. Dhawan sets off for a run and there is a chance for a run out for that fielder but he fumbles. 9 from this over also but this was a good over by Rubel.

This has been a good over from the bowler till now. He though has not had luck on his side. He once again bowls an outswinger on middle, Rohit closes the bat face early as he tries to flick. The ball takes the outside edge and goes down to third man for a run.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off, Sharma goes after it but misses.

BEAUTY! The grunt he is letting out while delivering the ball shows how much effort he is putting. On a length around off, shoots off the surface. Rohit pushes at it tentatively but luckily for him he does not edge it.
That came back in late! Fuller around off, shapes in late. Dhawan tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge beside the pitch and the batsmen scamper through for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Rohit guides it down to third man to change strike.

Edged but FOUR! A good delivery to begin with by Rubel. He lands it on a length around off, it skids off the surface and also straightens. Sharma tries to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes down to the third man fence.
Rubel Hossain is into the attack.
Just like the last over a dot to finish but nine from this over also. On the pads, Dhawan fails to put it away and gets hit high on the pads.
A yorker on middle, tries to surprise the batsman. Sharma though gets his bat down in time and works it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Bad ball and dispatched! Short and wide outside off, width on offer and Sharma pounces on it. He cuts it through point and the ball races away. India off to a flier, 123 needed now.
Fuller on middle, Sharma eases it down to mid on.
FOUR! Classic Rohit Sharma! A little short by Taskin on off, Rohit nonchalantly rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary.
A peach to start off with! Taskin comes running in and angles it into the off stump first. Gets it to leave the batsman late. Rohit tries to defend but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge.
Taskin Ahmed to bowl the second over.
A dot to end the first over, an expensive one though. Down the leg side, Dhawan watches it go through to the keeper.
Works it against the angle and through square leg for a run. A run of each ball till now.
Good delivery! Back of a length and he bent his back on this one as it bounces a touch more. Hurries onto the batsman as he tries to flick, takes the glove and rolls towards the leg side for a run.
Over compensates and bowls it on the pads, Dhawan though does not take full toll of it as he flicks it not off the middle, over mid on for a couple.
FOUR! Starts from where he left off in the last game! Off the mark in style. Short and wide outside off, Dhawan guides it through point and the ball races away.
India are underway as Sharma guides a length ball outside off down towards third man for an easy run.

We are back for the chase. 140 is the target as the Bangladesh players make their way out to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan will open the batting for India. Mustafizur Rahman will start the bowling for the Bangla Tigers. Here we go...
